applicant.name: Mag. Daniel Hörtnagl
applicant.organisation: Österreichische Gesellschaft für Psychische Gesundheit, Arbeitsgruppe Versorgungsforschung

purpose: We are preparing a position paper for the federal states on access to treatment for depression. We want to see whether drug treatment rates differ between regions, as a first indicator of unequal access to care.
question: In each federal state, how many adults have been diagnosed with depression and how many of them are currently taking an SSRI antidepressant?
definitions: Adults are people who were at least 18 years old at the end of 2025.
Depression means a recorded diagnosis of a depressive episode.
SSRI antidepressants means the drug class of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors.
Currently taking means the prescription had started by 31 December 2025 and had not ended before that day.
Treatment rate = adults with depression currently taking an SSRI / adults with depression × 100, one decimal.
Report per federal state: adults with depression, how many of them currently take an SSRI and the treatment rate.
